sections.heading: How to wear ?
sections.text:
• Wear Daily to stay calm and balanced

Wear it on either hand based on your intention. The left hand is believed to receive energy — ideal if you want to invite calmness and clarity. The right hand helps radiate energy — perfect when you want to express confidence and strength.

• Best Day to Wear

Wear the Dhyana Sutra Bracelet on Monday morning to align with calmness, emotional balance, and mindful clarity.

• Set Intentions

Take a quiet moment before wearing it. Set a simple intention like clear thinking, emotional stability, or inner peace. Let the bracelet remind you of that intention throughout the day.

• Cleanse Regularly 

Place your bracelet under moonlight or on the Selenite Recharging plate to gently cleanse and refresh its energy.

 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 🧘♂️💜 Dhyana Sutra Bracelet

✨ Studd Muffyn Exclusive – Created for Inner Calm, Emotional Strength & Clear Thinking

In a world full of distractions, attention is power. Clarity is strength. Balanced Mind is control.The Dhyana Sutra Bracelet is designed for those who don’t just think — they seek mastery over their thoughts.

At the center sits a peaceful Buddha charm — a gentle reminder to slow down… take a deep breath… and respond with awareness instead of reacting quickly.

Around it flows a carefully chosen crystal combination:

Clear Quartz helps clear your mind and strengthen your intentions.Lepidolite supports emotional balance and reduces overthinking.Labradorite gives inner strength and supports better decisions during tough moments.Amethyst brings calmness and a peaceful mindset.Aura Quartz adds positivity and light energy to your daily aura.

Together, these crystals create a balanced flow — calming your mind while keeping you strong and focused.

All crystals used are 100% authentic and quality tested, having gone through multiple-step verification processes to ensure purity and originality.

Simple in design yet meaningful in purpose, this bracelet is handcrafted with neat detailing, making it stylish for daily wear. Wear it during meditation, work, travel, or on days when you just need to feel more centered and clearer.

Each piece is delivered in a premium and sturdy designer Kappa box, ensuring safe packaging and a luxurious unboxing experience.

💜 Let this bracelet remind you every day: stay calm, stay aware, stay balanced.

Note: As crystals are natural, slight differences in color and texture may occur. Each bracelet is unique.

Disclaimer: The Dhyana Sutra Bracelet is designed to support calmness, clarity, and emotional balance through intention and belief. It works best when combined with your own awareness, effort, and positive actions.
